mapper.sql: t.id, t.instance_id, t.node_instance_id, t.assignee_id, t.origin_assignee_id, t.delegate_from, t.add_sign_type, t.status, t.opinion, t.decided_at, t.handover_reason, t.created_at, t.updated_at

t.id AS task_id, t.instance_id, i.biz_no, i.form_type, i.category, ni.node_seq AS node_seq, ni.node_name AS node_name, ni.node_code AS node_code, t.assignee_id, t.origin_assignee_id, t.delegate_from, t.add_sign_type, t.status AS task_status, t.opinion, t.handover_reason, DATE_FORMAT(t.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS task_created_at, DATE_FORMAT(t.decided_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS decided_at, i.initiator_id, u.name AS initiator_name, i.current_node_seq, i.status AS instance_status, i.sub_status
mapper.select: SELECT FROM flow_task t JOIN flow_instance i ON i.id = t.instance_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=flow_instance, alias=i) */ AND t.id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM flow_task t JOIN flow_instance i ON i.id = t.instance_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=flow_instance, alias=i) */ AND t.node_instance_id = #{nodeInstanceId} ORDER BY t.id ASC

SELECT FROM flow_task t JOIN flow_instance i ON i.id = t.instance_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=flow_instance, alias=i) */ AND t.node_instance_id = #{nodeInstanceId} AND t.add_sign_type IS NULL ORDER BY t.id ASC

SELECT FROM flow_task t JOIN flow_instance i ON i.id = t.instance_id JOIN flow_node_instance ni ON ni.id = t.node_instance_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=flow_instance, alias=i) */ AND t.node_instance_id = #{nodeInstanceId} AND t.add_sign_type IS NULL AND (ni.started_at IS NULL OR t.created_at >= ni.started_at) ORDER BY t.id ASC

SELECT FROM flow_task t JOIN flow_instance i ON i.id = t.instance_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=flow_instance, alias=i) */ AND t.node_instance_id = #{nodeInstanceId} AND t.add_sign_type IS NULL AND t.status = 'pending' ORDER BY t.id ASC

SELECT FROM flow_task t JOIN flow_instance i ON i.id = t.instance_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=flow_instance, alias=i) */ AND t.instance_id = #{instanceId} AND t.assignee_id = #{assigneeId} AND t.add_sign_type IS NULL AND t.status = 'pending' ORDER BY t.id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM flow_task t JOIN flow_instance i ON i.id = t.instance_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=flow_instance, alias=i) */ AND t.instance_id = #{instanceId} AND t.status = 'pending'

SELECT FROM flow_task t JOIN flow_instance i ON i.id = t.instance_id LEFT JOIN flow_node_instance ni ON ni.id = t.node_instance_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = i.initiator_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=flow_instance, alias=i) */ AND t.instance_id = #{instanceId} ORDER BY t.id ASC

SELECT FROM flow_task t JOIN flow_instance i ON i.id = t.instance_id LEFT JOIN flow_node_instance ni ON ni.id = t.node_instance_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = i.initiator_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=flow_instance, alias=i) */ AND t.assignee_id = #{userId} AND t.status = 'pending' ORDER BY t.created_at DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM flow_task t JOIN flow_instance i ON i.id = t.instance_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=flow_instance, alias=i) */ AND t.assignee_id = #{userId} AND t.status = 'pending'

SELECT FROM flow_task t JOIN flow_instance i ON i.id = t.instance_id LEFT JOIN flow_node_instance ni ON ni.id = t.node_instance_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = i.initiator_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=flow_instance, alias=i) */ AND t.assignee_id = #{userId} AND t.status <> 'pending' ORDER BY t.decided_at DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM flow_task t JOIN flow_instance i ON i.id = t.instance_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=flow_instance, alias=i) */ AND t.assignee_id = #{userId} AND t.status <> 'pending'

SELECT NULL AS task_id, i.id AS instance_id, i.biz_no, i.form_type, i.category, i.current_node_seq AS node_seq, (SELECT n2.node_name FROM flow_node_instance n2 WHERE n2.instance_id = i.id AND n2.node_seq = i.current_node_seq ORDER BY n2.id ASC LIMIT 1) AS node_name, NULL AS node_code, NULL AS assignee_id, NULL AS origin_assignee_id, NULL AS delegate_from, NULL AS add_sign_type, NULL AS task_status, NULL AS opinion, NULL AS handover_reason, DATE_FORMAT(i.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS task_created_at, DATE_FORMAT(i.finished_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS decided_at, i.initiator_id, u.name AS initiator_name, i.current_node_seq, i.status AS instance_status, i.sub_status FROM flow_instance i LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = i.initiator_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=flow_instance, alias=i) */ AND i.initiator_id = #{userId} ORDER BY i.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM flow_instance i WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=flow_instance, alias=i) */ AND i.initiator_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO flow_task (instance_id, node_instance_id, assignee_id, origin_assignee_id, delegate_from, add_sign_type, status, opinion) VALUES (#{instanceId}, #{nodeInstanceId}, #{assigneeId}, #{originAssigneeId}, #{delegateFrom}, #{addSignType}, IFNULL(#{status}, 'pending'), #{opinion})
mapper.update: UPDATE flow_task SET status = #{status}, opinion = #{opinion}, decided_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'pending'
UPDATE flow_task SET status = 'auto_closed', decided_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE node_instance_id = #{nodeInstanceId} AND status = 'pending'
UPDATE flow_task SET status = 'auto_closed', decided_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND status = 'pending'
UPDATE flow_task SET status = #{status}, handover_reason = #{handoverReason}, decided_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'pending'
